text:
Priya Shah: heads-up — doing a quick pass on the audit log panel copy and visual density. posted a screenshot in the doc: https://redwood.app/drive/audit-log-ui-v3 :eyes: Rory Chen: looking now. main thing i noticed: rows feel dense when you have long event names + region chips. hard to scan for timestamps. Devon Martinez: agree. maybe reduce per-row vertical padding and increase separation between the primary row and metadata line? currently both are same weight. Priya Shah: my concern is accessibility — when rows are denser we lose clear focus targets for keyboard nav. aria-focus order needs to be explicit for the expand/copy actions. Aisha Patel: tiny copy nit: audit entries say "User action recorded" which feels passive. suggest "Action recorded by {actor}" or "Recorded by {actor}" — gives clearer subject. Rory Chen: +1 to making the actor the subject. also for cross-region events we currently show a single region chip. should we show "Primary region: EU-west" vs "Regions: EU, US" when multiples? that helps compliance reviews. Priya Shah: yes, show plural when >1. and make the chips truncatable but reveal full list on hover. aria-label should read "Regions: EU-west, US-east" so screenreader gets the full set. Devon Martinez: regarding encryption/KMS labels: status pill currently reads "Key present" or "Owned by user" — very ambiguous. suggest new states: "Managed key (Redwood)", "Customer key (BYOK)", "No key". shorter but clearer. Aisha Patel: i like the explicit phrasing. can we use a concise tooltip copy: "Managed key: Redwood manages encryption key" and "Customer key: key in customer KMS"? keeps clarity for reviewers. Priya Shah: another edge: toggling retention policy shows a toast "Retention updated" but the toast isn't announced by screenreaders. need aria-live="polite" on that container and include the policy name in the message: e.g., "Data retention set to 90 days (default)." Rory Chen: good catch. also the toast disappears after 3s; for long policy names / copy -> consider 5s or require explicit dismiss if change is destructive. Devon Martinez: UX microflow question — when a region fallback is in effect (e.g., EU primary, fallback US), should the UI show a small warning row in the audit entry? can be a gray label "served from fallback region" with info link. Aisha Patel: yes, we should surface fallback. compliance teams often miss that. Copy proposal: "Served from fallback region — data may traverse US infrastructure. See policy." Priya Shah: also low-level: the list uses a 1px divider line that looks like a rendering glitch in high-contrast mode. bump to 2px or use a soft shadow. Rory Chen: note for engineering — when we collapse long prompt traces we currently strip timestamps from sub-events. keep timestamps for collapsed summary rows. Devon Martinez: code suggestion for aria announcement on expand: ```
Show details
...details...
``` Priya Shah: perfect. i'll update mockups with the new KMS label variants, tooltip copy, toast aria string, and a low-density list option for power users. Aisha Patel: quick copy for audit log header: replace "Activity" with "Audit activity" — small but helps legal reviewers find it. Rory Chen: +:thumbsup: from infra — also adding a perf note: switching to the lower-density mode needs to keep virtualization, otherwise we drown memory for big accounts. console-bot: deploy-preview: audit-log-ui/v3 uploaded by @Priya Shah — preview URL: https://staging.redwood.app/audit-log/v3 (expires in 48h) :rocket: Priya Shah: thanks all. i'll push an updated Figma link and a short changelist. leaving this thread open for any final microcopy tweaks. Rory Chen: one last: for export CSV header, use full phrases (e.g., "Actor Name", "Event Time", "Region(s)") to match UI labels. makes legal audits easier. Aisha Patel: noted. i'll add to the copy doc. :sparkles:
